seo_article_outline.source_summary_for_editor: Hey HN! We're Alireza and Majid building Leeroo ( https://leeroo.com/ ). Previously we’ve built AI systems for products with millions of users, including at LinkedIn and Meta. We’re now focusing on building AI systems for enterprise data. Today, we're open-sourcing Kapso ( https://github.com/Leeroo-AI/kapso ), an engine that runs experiments, deploys the best solution, and learns from every run. The nature of data work is iterative: investigate, form hypotheses, experiment, and improve based on what you learn. This bottom-up process is the only way to deliver meaningful outcomes quickly in large, messy enterprise data environments. Consultants gathering context in meetings or teams defining a business ontology upfront to fit into the data has no chance of execution, in quarters and sometimes years. An AI-native system should automate this process, compounding learning to each new investigation and implementation. For instance, one of our enterprise projects was moving a company off it
